summary: F-5 deployment-preparation retry BLOCKED before HPAC-PPA presentation-mechanism registration. Provisioned the HPAC-PAWA production protected root at /Library/Application Support/PCAE/HPAC/protected-root via the canonical unmodified scripts/hpac_protected_root_admin.py provision --agent-account atilamadai (read-only-confirmed sole real OS account); installed the exact immutable Git-sourced protected-presentation helper bytes (src/pcae/protected_presentation_helper.py, commit 2e416e9b, blob d80abf74, SHA-256 933c66464516080b91fa2b5e7e2b50ea176a5887058bc63a51ddb083c9ea6182) at their content-addressed destination. scripts/hpac_protected_presentation_admin.py install then failed: _resolve_trusted_executable/_current_agent_identity in hatp_class_b_topology_verifier.py evaluate the LIVE deployment-owner euid (root, under sudo) rather than the configured PCAE agent principal (atilamadai/uid 501), so root's own ownership of ordinary PATH directories (/usr/bin, /bin, ...) makes the ACL-inspection tool-trust walk (_resolve_trusted_executable('ls')) return None unconditionally whenever invoked as root -- cascading to acl_inspection_unavailable / protected_root_untrusted for every ancestor of the protected root. Reproduced identically under the operator's normal PATH, under a sudo env PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin restriction (confirmed via direct os.environ inspection that the restriction reached the process), and via independent unprivileged reproduction of the PATH-precedence walk -- ruling out PATH/sudo-environment content as the root cause. No production source, script, or normative contract was modified; no workaround or repair was attempted. The registration transaction failed at its own precondition check with no partial or ambiguous write: scripts/hpac_protected_presentation_admin.py status reports 'no presentation-mechanism installation' identically before and after the attempt. F-5: OPEN / BLOCKED (protected root + helper bytes now durably provisioned; presentation-mechanism registration not achieved). N-16-5 remains NOT CLOSED.

Independently reproduced via direct Python invocation of the same functions both unprivileged and (by the operator, in their own terminal) as root via sudo.
